title: The Insider Unmasked
next_chapter_hook: Just as the crowd in the Council Hall had yet to disperse, an urgent transmission Jade Slip pierced through the air—Mo Xiansheng's aged yet commanding voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind: 'Return quickly! Something major has happened at the Tianqing Sect! The matter regarding Han Lie has other hidden truths!'

text.content: In the Council Hall, the atmosphere was heavy as iron. Chen Ji stood among the assembled alliance elders, hands clasped behind his back, his expression calm as still water, yet his mind was crystal clear—he was waiting, waiting for the already laid trap to draw the prey into the deadly ground. Three days ago, he had used the Tianji Record to glimpse the scene three hours later: Han Lie would, at today's alliance council meeting, hand the marching route of the three sects' joint army to the Demonic Path messenger.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, you are merely a Menial Servant—on what authority do you presume to lecture us here?

text.content: Before Han Lie could finish speaking, Chen Ji smiled faintly. That smile was so gentle it seemed almost weak, like a kind-hearted person being bullied. However, in the next moment, he swept his sleeve, and several beams of Spiritual Light shot out, coalescing in mid-air into a clear scene—it was Han Lie secretly meeting a black-robed figure in the middle of the night, and the item being traded was unmistakably a Jade Slip marked with the three sects' joint army marching route.

dialogue.content: Senior Brother Han, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, at the third quarter hour after midnight last night at Luoxia Slope, had a secret meeting with a Demonic Path messenger for half an hour. This is recorded by the 'Shadow Stone'—Senior Brother Han, would you care to explain?
You... you are slandering me! This is fabricated!

text.content: Han Lie's furious roars echoed through the Council Hall, yet his face had already visibly paled. Chen Ji watched coldly—faced with irrefutable evidence, excuses would only make one appear more pathetic. He stepped forward slowly, his voice still flat as water, yet each word struck at the heart.

dialogue.content: Fabricated? The Shadow Stone is uniformly distributed by the alliance, each one bearing an independent spiritual imprint that cannot be altered by anyone else. If Senior Brother Han does not believe it, feel free to ask any of the elders present to verify it on the spot.

text.content: Murmurs immediately erupted throughout the Council Hall, everyone's gazes falling on Han Lie. Sweat beaded on Han Lie's forehead, yet he stubbornly refused to admit defeat. At this critical moment, the doors of the Council Hall burst open, and a dignified, aged voice rang out from outside—

dialogue.content: Enough! Let's see who dares to openly frame a disciple of our Tianqing Sect on alliance grounds!

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly—Ling Yuan, the Law Enforcement Elder of the Tianqing Sect, whose cultivation was said to have reached the peak of Transformation God, capable of dominating the sect with absolute power. The moment he stepped into the Council Hall, rolling waves of oppressive might came crashing down like mountains collapsing, causing everyone present to change color. Yet when Han Lie saw the newcomer, a hint of barely perceptible joy flashed in his eyes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, is it? A Menial Servant disciple dares to cause trouble here? This so-called 'evidence'—in my opinion, it is merely petty trickery intended to confuse the audience!

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's oppressive might pressed down like a physical force. Chen Ji faced a desperate situation—the sect's high-ranking officials were openly showing favoritism—should he fight head-on or endure in silence?

choices.description: Publicly expose the connection between Ling Yuan and Han Lie, drag the old fox down with evidence, regardless of offending sect powerhouses.
choices.visible_cost: Publicly offending the Law Enforcement Elder of Tianqing Sect places one in an extremely dangerous political position.
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly expose the insider network within the alliance, Han Lie's reputation destroyed with no chance of a comeback.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan has deep roots; direct confrontation may backfire and bring trouble upon oneself.

dialogue.content: Elder Ling, what impressive authority you wield. Since you are the Law Enforcement Elder, surely you understand that everyone is equal before the law—may I ask where Elder was stationed last night at the third quarter hour?

choices.description: Sheathe your blade and make a temporary concession to preserve strength and wait for a better opportunity. Since Ling Yuan is protective, he will inevitably reveal more flaws in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie temporarily escapes punishment; the insider plot remains unbroken.
choices.visible_reward: Protect yourself and win sympathy from other elders present, accumulating political capital for future counterattacks.
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's arrogance will grow even more severe; he may accelerate his collusion with the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: Since Elder Ling has spoken, this disciple shall naturally comply. However... the evidence has already been presented; truth resides in people's hearts. This disciple will say no more today.

choices.memory_label: 陈机隐忍退让，苏青瑶目睹全程

choices.description: Do not directly confront Ling Yuan; instead, direct the spear toward other forces within the alliance, letting a third party impose constraints—killing with a borrowed knife.
choices.visible_cost: Requires exposing more trump cards to earn allies' trust.
choices.visible_reward: Suppress Ling Yuan through external forces while expanding one's influence within the alliance.
choices.risk_hint: May invite wolves into the house, allowing other forces to seize the opportunity to meddle in Tianqing Sect's internal affairs.

dialogue.content: Elder Ling speaks wisely. However, this disciple dares to ask—do any of you recognize this Demonic Path messenger shown in the Shadow Stone? This person is precisely the 'Blood Evil Emissary' who has been wanted by the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path for years. If there were no insider to provide assistance, how could such a person have infiltrated the alliance's heartland?

text.content: A flash of killing intent flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes before vanishing, replaced by his facade of a benevolent elder. However, his gaze toward Chen Ji carried additional gloom. Chen Ji's heart was like a mirror—this old fox has extremely deep scheming; today's matter will not end here. Yet what he understood even more clearly was: the chess game has already been set; the endgame is merely a matter of time.

dialogue.content: Elder Ling, calm your anger. Since today's matter has been submitted to alliance arbitration, it should be handled according to alliance rules. This disciple suggests—why not first isolate Han Shidi for investigation, and wait until the truth is clarified before making a final decision? This way, we can also give an explanation to the world.

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice was neither servile nor overbearing, yet it precisely struck Ling Yuan's weakness—if he truly tried to forcibly protect Han Lie, he would be openly defying alliance rules and giving others leverage. Ling Yuan's expression shifted slightly, but he had no choice but to temporarily suppress his anger. He flicked his sleeve with a cold hmph and said nothing more.

choice.prompt: The situation temporarily reached a stalemate. Su Qingyao secretly cast Chen Ji a meaningful glance—she seemed to have important intelligence she wished to share privately.

choices.description: Meet privately with Su Qingyao to hear the core intelligence she possesses regarding Tianqing Sect's internal personnel relationships.
choices.visible_cost: Requires spending time in in-depth communication with Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on Ling Yuan's relationship with sect internal factions, providing key leverage for future counterattacks.
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered meeting privately with Su Qingyao, triggering more suspicion.

text.content: After the council meeting ended, Chen Ji left the Council Hall calmly. Su Qingyao's figure followed like a shadow. The two stopped in a secluded corner of the side hall. After Su Qingyao confirmed there was no one around, she lowered her voice to speak.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶主动提供情报，两人关系更近一步

choices.description: No need to act hastily; continue observing Ling Yuan and Han Lie's movements to find more leverage.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the window of opportunity to obtain crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan and Han Lie may relax their guard because of this, revealing more flaws.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's favorability may decrease because of this.

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head slightly, signaling Su Qingyao not to act rashly for now. His gaze越过人群，落在凌渊那宽阔的背影上，心中默默记下了今日这笔账——不急，有的是时间。

Outside the Council Hall, the night wind was cold and sharp. Han Lie's retreating figure, being escorted away by alliance law enforcement disciples, was狼狈不堪。临走时 Ling Yuan's阴冷的眼神，陈机看得分明——这老狐狸今日颜面尽失，日后必会寻机报复。然而，陈机嘴角却勾起一抹淡淡的笑意。

dialogue.content: 你笑什么？凌渊可不是善茬，他背后还有……

text.content: 苏青瑶欲言又止，陈机却抬手止住了她的话头。月色下，他的面容平静如水，唯有眼底深处闪烁着计算的光芒——凌渊？不过是棋盘上的一枚棋子罢了。他真正在意的，是那枚棋子背后执棋之人的真正意图。

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao seems to possess crucial intelligence about Ling Yuan, but before revealing it, she needs to confirm one thing...

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao partial truth about the Tianji Record Fragment in exchange for her complete trust and core intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing one's trump card, reducing the sense of mystery in front of Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain all intelligence Su Qingyao possesses about Ling Yuan, with a significant increase in favorability.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may be unable to accept the truth, leading to a collapse of trust.

dialogue.content: 你……你说的'预知'是什么意思？难道你真的能……

choices.memory_label: 陈机首次向苏青瑶袒露部分真相，两人关系质变

choices.description: Do not fully reveal the existence of the Tianji Record, only use vague hints to exchange for Su Qingyao's intelligence, maintaining one's own mysterious advantage.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger Su Qingyao's dissatisfaction, affecting the depth of cooperation.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the required intelligence without fully exposing one's trump card.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may sense that Chen Ji is hiding something, thereby creating a rift.

dialogue.content: 你总是这样……罢了，我先告诉你。凌渊最近与玄武宗的一位太上长老走得很近，这次针对韩烈的调查，恐怕没那么简单。

text.content: 夜色渐深，陈机独自立于庭院之中。月光如水，洒在他清瘦的身影上，仿佛披上了一层银霜。今日之计，虽未能一击必杀，却也成功将韩烈推上了风口浪尖。而凌渊的介入，更是让这盘棋的层次陡然拔高。

dialogue.content: 凌渊、玄武宗太上长老……有意思。看来这张网，比我想象的还要大。

text.content: 陈机缓缓闭上双眼，天机录残页在意识深处微微发热。然而他很快压下了那股窥探未来的冲动——天命值何其珍贵，岂能浪费在这等小事之上。他有的是耐心，有的是时间。欠下的账，总有人要来还。就在他准备回房休息之时，一道急促的传音玉简破空而至，墨先生苍老而威严的声音在脑海中炸响："速归！天青宗出了大事，韩烈之事另有蹊跷！"陈机面色微变，这一日的博弈，竟还未到终局。
